topic: Prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication in LEO constellations
consensus_response: The optimal satellite spacing and constellation patterns, combined with the inherent advantages of V-band, justify its prioritization over optical systems for robust and efficient inter-satellite communication in LEO constellations.
reference_context: The discussion highlighted the advantages of V-band in terms of reduced atmospheric absorption, lower interference, and simpler alignment requirements. Hexagonal or circular constellation patterns were identified as optimal for minimizing gaps and ensuring balanced coverage.
